title: fix(spec,lint): the refusal of a total over a formula field names a stored computed field, not a hook
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiYBQN7MPT7n8UHTG9z3Lpap)_
Fixes #32443
Fixes #32506

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up #32532
Related: #32527 #32528 #32529 #32554

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:对公式字段做合计/平均被拒时,修复提示不再说「存成数字字段、由 hook 维护」,改为「把它做成公式返回类型的字段、带同一个 `expression`(写入时计算并存储),再汇总它」。返回类型而不是一律 number:日期公式要用 date 字段,实测同一表达式放在 number 字段上每次写入都被拒。spec 常量、lint 的四条规则与 os explain、数据集编译报错都打印这一句;按维度分组公式的提示也指向同一做法。
- 为什么改:裁定 B(存储型公式)要的能力平台已经有了:非公式字段带 `expression` 就是写入时计算、落列的存储计算字段,sum/avg 本来就能用。缺的是报错没指向它,反而指向托管档用不了的 hook。实测请假案例:插入、按 id 改日期后重算、数据集按类型求和都正确。os explain 也写明两条限制:转换前的旧行在补算前为空;表达式在写入时求值一次(读时钟或当前用户的表达式保留写入时的值)。
- 风险与回滚:只改提示文案和测试,不改任何接受/拒绝结果,不加新键。已知限制:把已有公式改成存储字段后,旧行在补算前是空值,合计偏低;补算命令 `os migrate stored-expressions --apply` 需要直连数据库,托管目前没有入口(跟进卡 #32527)。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/data/aggregate-field-type-compatibility.ts`(新句与说明)、`packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/stored-computed-field-dataset-total.test.ts`(端到端钉住)、`packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`(os explain 四处逐字收录)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run src/__tests__/stored-computed-field-dataset-total.test.ts`,预期 6 个用例全过:公式求和被拒并打印新句,存储字段插入、改动后按类型合计为 annual 8 / sick 1,再变为 sick 3;日期表达式在 date 字段上落列、在 number 字段上被拒。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The maintainer ruled B on #32443 (comment 6810299283, 「32443 直接做 B，其他同意」): a computed value that is stored on write, kept in a column and recomputed when its inputs change, so that `sum` / `avg` work on it. Measured on this tree, that mechanism already exists: a non-`formula` field carrying an `expression` is a stored computed field (`expression` on `FieldSchema`). The engine computes it from the row each write stores and stores the result. What was missing is the refusal pointing at it. It pointed at a hook instead, which an author on a hosted tier may not be able to add. The spec seat ruled route 1 (no new key) on that measurement.

- **`VIRTUAL_FIELD_AGGREGATE_REMEDY`** (`@objectstack/spec/data`), the one sentence the refusals of `sum` / `avg` / `min` / `max` over a `formula` print, now reads: "Computed on read, the field stores no value: make it a field of its return type with the same `expression` (computed and stored on write) and aggregate that. Counting records is a different question." (199 characters, inside the 200-character `fix:` bound.)
- **The return type, not `number` for every formula.** A `min` / `max` over a date formula (a list-view group order asks exactly that) has its stored answer in a `date` field. The same expression on a `number` field computes a date the record validator refuses on every write (measured: `VALIDATION_FAILED`, "last_day must be a number"). The old sentence said "number field" too.
- **The stored field's limits, in the TSDoc and in `os explain measure-aggregate-field-type-refused`.** Rows stored before the field gained its `expression` hold no value until each is written again or `os migrate stored-expressions --apply` fills them, so a total over them reads low. And the expression is evaluated once, at the write, with the writer's clock, user and permissions, where a formula re-reads it.
- **Surface-neutral (absorbs #32506).** The sentence no longer names `count` / `count_distinct`. A list-view column summary spells that count `count_unique`, and the same sentence is printed there, so it named a value that surface cannot take.
- **`os explain`.** `measure-aggregate-field-type-refused`, `list-view-summary-field-type-refused`, `list-view-group-order-unorderable` and `grid-aggregation-field-type-refused` print the sentence as their fix line; each explanation now holds it verbatim. `dimension-virtual-field-refused` (a group key over a formula) and `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` point at the same mechanism: a field of the formula's `returnType` carrying the same `expression`.
- **Comments** in `dataset-compiler.ts` and `validate-dataset-measure-aggregates.ts` that paraphrased the old sentence now paraphrase the new one.

## Tests

- New `packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/stored-computed-field-dataset-total.test.ts`, the card's case end to end over a real `ObjectQL` engine on `SqlDriver` (SQLite) with `AnalyticsServicePlugin`, on both analytics strategies (native SQL and the engine aggregate): the formula `sum` is refused `DATASET_INVALID` / 400 naming the remedy; an insert stores the computed day count over a client-sent value; a batch insert (the import path) computes each row; a dataset `sum` grouped by leave type answers the true totals; an update by id that moves an input stores the recomputed value and the total follows. A second block pins the return type: a date expression is stored on a `date` field and refused on a `number` field.
- `validate-dataset-measure-aggregates.test.ts`: following the fix line clears the finding (the same expression on a `number` field passes for all four aggregates, where on a `formula` it is refused with the remedy).
- Each printer's pin moved to the new sentence: spec `aggregate-field-type-compatibility.test.ts` (names a field of its return type with the same `expression`, never "number field", no hook, no aggregate spelling of a count; `number` is accepted for all four rows and `date` for `min` / `max`), the lint measure / list-view summary / grid pins, and the analytics compile-leg pin. The list-view summary test now holds every hint it fired free of `count_distinct`, the virtual-field one included, where it used to exempt it.

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured before building** (scratch probe, not committed): the gaps against the ruling's wording are filed by the spec seat as their own cards, none blocking the card's case. (a, #32527) Rows stored before a formula becomes a stored computed field hold NULL until written again, so a total over them reads low. `os migrate stored-expressions --apply` fills them, and the boot names them, but the command needs a direct database URL, so a hosted tenant has no way to run it today. (b, #32528) A predicate update that moves an input to values that differ per row is refused (`VALIDATION_FAILED`, nothing written); REST batch, import and the console's bulk update go by id and compute per row, so only a flow `update_record` with `multi: true` reaches it. (c, #32529) An expression input read through a lookup is not recomputed when the referenced record changes, and authoring says nothing. (d, #32554) An expression reading `now()` / `today()`, the current user or `can()` keeps the writer's value, where a formula is evaluated per read; nothing at authoring says so. Batch insert and import compute.
- **Hosted tier.** `RestrictionProfileSchema` carries four rule keys, and `judgeRestrictionProfile` never reads object fields, so `expression` on a stored field is allowed at every tier. A live hosted tenant was not measured.
- **Skills.** The skills guidance (the leave-days example in the dashboards rules, the matching eval, the formula row of the field-types table) is carried by #32532: an implementation card carries no `skills/**` edit.
- **Deviation.** The claim declared `Metadata-protocol: unchanged`; the gate's closed set is `added | narrowed | semantic | none`, so this PR and its changeset declare `none`, as the seat agreed.

## Verification

All readings below were taken at head `daddb8446` (the contract review's fixes on top of `f35587c1e`, which merged `origin/main` at merge base `216674301`). Every exit code was captured before any pipe.

- Typecheck: spec, lint and service-analytics :: exit 0 each. eslint (`--no-inline-config`) over `packages/spec/src/data`, `packages/lint/src` and `packages/services/service-analytics/src` :: exit 0. `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` :: exit 0.
- Derived gate families: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 113 families for this diff. The set is the same 113 at both heads. All 113 were run at `daddb8446`, with exit 0 each. `--ran` reconciliation: 113 derived, 113 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, a derived zero.
- Dogfood: not owed. The title carries no `!`, and `Clause-②: no` carries no `(narrowing)` arm.
- Contract review: owed on the spec and lint text. Round 1 (at `f35587c1e`) passed with three should-fix findings, all fixed in `daddb8446`; the delta review's record is posted as a comment on this PR, on the head it reviewed.
